lines.en: It was another night at Koi Cafe, which meant it was another chance for Haruka Hamasaki to sit down, relax, and be proud of herself for managing to create such a successful business in such a weird town.
Yet, as she glanced down at a sheet of paper with different types of milk splayed across it like a prostitute on a cocaine-lined glass table, she had something else on her mind.

You see, she was thinking about friendship. About ways to improve herself mentally so that she doesn’t wind up on the wrong side of the tracks again before being struck at full speed by a DC tilting EMU E353 Series train.
Yes, it would truly suck to be killed by one of 213 aluminum alloy-bodied vehicles constructed between 2015 and 2019 with a car length of 20,000 (21,000 on the ends) and a maximum speed of 130 kmph.

She’d much rather be one of the 686 people riding it at maximum capacity from Shinjuku to Kōfu as a part of the limited express Kaiji service, complete with free passenger Wifi, trolley service, and excellent views of Mt. Fuji.

Was she thinking about it this specifically, though? No. This is just a metaphor. A long one. In fact, Haruka had only taken such a train one time in her life — on a trip to see her aunt and uncle in Yamanashi.
They didn’t matter right now, though. Not just because they weren’t on her mind, but because they had been struck by a DC tilting EMU E353 Series train over a decade ago.
Hey, have you ever noticed how the bass line in this song sounds like a beating heart?
Anyway, Haruka. Rin. Two girls in one place — the place that they worked.
No trains. No customers (they were closed right now). Just milk and a mountain of problems that wouldn’t be able to drink that milk because they are problems and problems don’t have mouths.
Seriously, though — what if this song is alive?
: Rin. Try to push skim milk over the next few days. I ordered too much of it and I don’t want it to go bad.
: You didn’t order too much. Kids these days just don’t care about fat intake the way they used to.
: Yeah, that was all we talked about when I was growing up. I never paid much attention, though.
: Well, maybe if you did, your boobs wouldn’t be the size of hot air balloons?
: Yeah, I think you’re right. I should round up every other large-breasted millennial and file a class action lawsuit against Big Milk for when our backs all break in ten more years.
: I bet “Big Milk” is what they called you in high school.
: Please, no. I’ve gotten enough nicknames from Molly. The last thing I want is for “Big Milk” to catch on.
: With Molly, it’d probably be something more like...Gigantimilk, Envoy of All that Lactates or something.
: On second thought, I guess Big Milk is fine. I’m going to call you Little Milk, though.
: Aww, we’re like those little ladle constellations. Maybe they’ve been scooping up milk this entire time and Neil deGrasse Tyson just hasn’t figured it out yet.
: Yeah, maybe. You almost done over there? You were supposed to clock out ten minutes ago.
: Rin? You okay?
: Yeah! And...I’m done. I’ve been done, actually. But, uhh...
: Actually, uhh...let me clock out first. I don’t want to-
: Is it depression again? Because I told you I don’t want you forcing yourself to work if-
: No! No, it’s not that...It’s just...
: Well, remember how I told you my mom took my phone away for the foreseeable future?
: I literally just gave you a raise. I can’t give you another one.
: I don’t need another raise. I need...advice. And I definitely don’t want to talk to my mom about it since that’s kind of how I got into this mess in the first place.
: I just...don’t know who else to turn to. And you’re practically a third mom to me at this point, so-
: Of course. You can ask me anything whenever you want.
: Okay, but...it’s gonna get graphic.
: You can definitely ask me anything whenever you want.
: Thennnnn...
: What does it...mean...when a girl goes down on you?
: You...made it this far into lesbianism without knowing what that means?
: N-No! I obviously know what it means! I just...don’t know what it means! Do you know what I mean?!
: Like...emotionally?
: Yes! That! Like...you would obviously have to like someone to do that, right? Especially if it was out of nowhere while you were really upset and confused and horny.
: I’m almost always upset, confused, and horny.
: Me too. That’s why we get along so well.
: Rin...did...
: Did this...actually happen?
: Will this conversation be able to proceed if I do not answer that question?
: No.
: Then...yeah.
: Well that’s great, isn’t it?! Who was it? Sana? I bet it was Sana.
: It was...Chika.
: Holy shit.
: Yeaaaaah.
: I...don’t get it, though. That’s awesome, isn’t it? You liked her for years. Shouldn’t you be happy about this?
: Yeah! I definitely should! But I’m still not really sure if it actually meant something! And what’s even more confusing is that I don’t know if I even want it to.
: Why...wouldn’t you want it to?
: Because...
: Because I...think I...have a crush on Sensei.
: And...
: And you’re just now realizing this?
: Apparently.
: You seriously didn’t know?
: You mean to tell me that all this time, you really never wanted to be with him? That you were totally cool with just bro-ing it up for the rest of your life?
: Why was it so obvious to everyone but me?...
: I’m sorry, I...didn’t mean for it sound like I was making fun of you. I just figured you knew that already.
: But yeah...if you’re interested in him now and you’re not interested in Chika anymore-
: I don’t know what I’m interested in, Haruka. Like, I thought I was over Chika. But then she decided to fucking go to town on me and now my heart starts freaking out again whenever she’s around.
: But you’re worried it didn’t mean anything to her...and you don’t want to overthink things like you always do.
: Yeah...
: Chika’s...
: She’s seemed...different lately. The Chika I know is, like...super faithful and would never cheat on Sensei since she genuinely believes they’re in a relationship.
: Oof.
: But now, all of a sudden, she’s just...okay with him seeing other girls? Like, she straight up told me she wanted to see the look on my face while he fucks me.
: Yeah, me too.
: What?
: Nothing! Uhh...so...so what are you asking me exactly? Just...for my feelings on what Chika did? Or...do you want to know where to go from here? Or...
: I’m just not really sure what to do. Chika is clearly the more logical choice here if she actually likes me. And going out with her wouldn’t get anybody in trouble. But, like...
: I really feel like my heart is pushing me toward Sensei this time. Even with all of the obstacles that are suddenly being thrown at me.
: Well...there’s your answer then.
: Really? That easy? You don’t think it’s weird for me to go after an adult instead of a girl my age?
: This isn’t any adult we’re talking about, Rin. It’s Sensei. You two are already like brother and sister, so you might as well just have sex already.
: I feel like that sentence would hit a lot differently if we weren’t both only childs...only children? Which one of those is grammatically correct? They both sound wrong.
: I don’t know, but I get what you’re saying. If you’re expecting me to talk you out of pursuing him, though...it’s not going to happen.
: I feel like it should.
: Probably, but the way I look at it is really simple.

: You two are clearly compatible despite the age difference. And I think the fact that you’ve managed to know each other for this long without hooking up is a testament to that. That’s impressive, Rin.
: But you’ve known him pretty much just as long as me and you haven’t had sex with him either. Are you saying that you’re compatible with him too?
: I’m married. You’re not. It’s different.
: I guess so. You two had sex pretty much right after meeting each other.
: Yes. I regret nothing and intend to stay his obedient little sex slave forever.
: This seems like a weird thing to say while pushing me to go after him.
: I just want you to be happy, Rin. That’s all I’ve ever wanted for you. And I just think that he is what would make you the happiest right now.
: Why do you think that, though? Why aren’t you worried about all the potential issues and...competition...the fact that my mom would fucking kill me?
: I have known you for a long time, Rin. I’ve seen you at your best, your worst, and everything in between.

: I watched the Chika drama unfold. The Otoha drama and the subsequent Molly drama. The Otoha drama again. And then every single customer who comes in with dyed hair and a crop top that you fall in love with.
: I am weak. We all know this.
: Yes. But this is the first time I have ever seen you approach a potential relationship maturely. And that just tells me you’re being extra careful not to fuck it up.

: Is Sensei the most politically correct choice? No. Is it something I think you should ask others for advice on? Definitely not. But that doesn’t change how it’s what I would do if I were in your shoes.
: So...love now...consequences later?
: Right.
: And...Chika? What do I do about her?
: Well, do you think she’s going to try and go down on you again?
: I hope so. That was awesome. Scary and kind of weird, but still awesome.
: But if you had to choose between her going down on you and having sex with Sensei-
: Western silverback.
: ...What?
: I said what I said.
: Yeah. And so did I. But advice is just advice at the end of the day, and I’ll support you no matter what you decide to do, Rin.
: Thank you, Haruka. Do I need to file a formal notice in advance if I want to request a hug?
: No. You may hug me whenever you like.
: Then here I come, Big Milk.
: I’ve got you, Little Milk.
: My boobs are actually big for my age.
: But they’ll never measure up to mine.
: So soft...so large...so comfortable...I could live here.
: Well, you’re welcome to stay as long as you like.
: No...it’s okay. I still haven’t clocked out yet and should probably be heading home soon.
: It’s fine. I’ll adjust your time manually.
: You don’t have to. I’ll just take the overtime pay.
: No. I’ll definitely adjust your time manually.
: Fiiiiiiine...
: Thank you, Haruka. I’m really glad you’re my boss.
: And I’m really glad you actually care about your job.
: I’m gonna finish cleaning up now, but you can feel free to use my phone if you want to sext Sensei.
: And risk sending my mom another five minute video of me masturbating? No thanks.
: Send her what?
: Night, Haruka! Thank you again! I’m glad your morals aren’t as strong as my mom’s!
: Night! And remember, we never spoke about any of this! I’m a morally good, law abiding woman outside of conversations with teenage girls asking me if they should act inappropriately!
: Just like the guy I like! Night!
: No! He’s kind of bad all the time! Night!
: Oh! And also remember to push skim milk! Even if you need convince all of your friends that fat intake matters!
: Too many things to remember! You have too much faith in me!
: You’re the only person I can have faith in! Everyone else is unreliable!
: That’s really sad! Anyway, goodnight! Again!
: Goodnight!
: And good luck...
As Rin exits the cafe, Haruka goes back to her clipboard — the one reminiscent of a whore.
: Hello?
: Hi.
: You should fuck Rin.
: Okay?
: Awesome. Good talk.
: Is...there a reason you are calling me in the middle of the night and telling me to fuck her?
: Of course.
: Is it because you want to fuck her? And me fucking her creates an opportunity for you to ultimately do that?
: While that may very well be true, I would implore you to fuck her even IF my inclusion was off the table.
: Yeah, because you’d still want to hear about it and you know I’d tell you.
: Again! That may be true. But-
: Don’t you think you two would be great?
: What are you talking about?
: Oh, don’t act like you wouldn’t go to hell and back for her. You care way more than you let on.
: Okay. But that still doesn’t warrant calling me out of nowhere to tell me this. What’s going on? Did something happen to her?
: See? You’re worried right now.
: No, I’m confused right now. You sound way less horny than you normally do when you name some teenager you want me to fuck.
: She’s falling for you, Akira. And if you don’t act quickly, you might lose your chance. You have competition this time.
: I always have competition when it comes to her and I have lost 100%% of the time.
: Yeah, well...this time’s different.
: Haruka-
: Just think about it, okay?
: And definitely fill me in on every single explicit detail if you do. Thanks.
Haruka goes back to her clipboard — the one reminiscent of a whore.
She doesn’t think about trains.
She doesn’t think about friendship either this time.
She thinks about how lonely she is.
And how there is only one person she’s met who would choose her over anyone else.
He’s so far away now.
She wonders if he’ll stay that way forever.
